verdict.rationale: The published pages document status checking: SOSPortal offers the 'Ability to check status and retrieve filings from the My Submissions page', and the homepage links to 'Track Business Filings'. However, status lookup appears to sit inside the account-based SOSPortal (My Submissions, MFA, $1 per search) rather than on openly accessible public pages, and the tracking flow itself is undescribed. missing for 10: evidence of a public, no-login status lookup page, documentation of what the 'Track Business Filings' tool shows (statuses, timelines), coverage of applications/cases beyond business filings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
